new_value: Go/no-go gate passed: memory budget validated, documented in lichen/README.md. Zephyr fits STM32WL with plenty of headroom.

Already completed: Memory budget validated 2026-06-24 (documented in lichen/README.md). STM32WL55 nucleo_wl55jc uses 78KB flash + 30KB RAM for Zephyr base, leaving ~140KB flash + ~20KB RAM for LICHEN protocol - well within <220KB flash/<50KB RAM targets. No RIOT fallback needed.
